description: Unofficial Mitsuri Kanroji fan-art companion inspired by Demon Slayer, with a closed opaque neckline, longer skirt and full dark leggings. Original foam-dumpling inspection, soft ribbon-heart craft, gentle braid stretches and three-direction jogging. Portrait-based face cues and familiar full-body adaptations are distinguished; no sword or revealing poses.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
